findings.text: the head-arm gate log's first line records revision 7c882130dec0027ba473f12e96eb3a9e8b10b6e5, the base sha, not the reviewed head 23f64fb234e918478098f19d7e79b6cfd2d0506e: the head gate ran with the change uncommitted, so the log cannot tell a later reader which tree produced 185 passed. Mitigated: the tree was clean at 23f64fb23, and an independent re-run of the same head gate at 23f64fb23 reproduced 185 passed EXIT=0.

the resolution fills estimated_hours from routing._estimated_hours, which returns the node's own figure when it carries one and otherwise the plan's plan-effort-hours meta; it never reads the section's data-effort-hours. For the reported node the routed state therefore carries 48.0 (the plan total) where the section declares 10.0. The implementation follows the SPEC as written, which named routing._estimated_hours as the estimate source, so this is an observation for the coordinator rather than a deviation.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 23f64fb23 against base 7c882130; it adds reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:_declared_difficulty and calls it from pick(), threads the resolved capability and estimate (plus a source label) through prompts.build_state into state.jinja, and adds tests/test_jev_sees_declared_difficulty.py. No other file changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: the SPEC's four items are present: repro_render.py shows the pre-change render (capability {} / estimated_hours null) for the reported node; _declared_difficulty resolves the section capability through routing.resolve_section_routing and the estimate through routing._estimated_hours, guarded so a failure leaves the field null; test_jev_sees_declared_difficulty.py covers the declared class/reasoning/risk via a synthetic plan, the request-carried capability, the node-carried estimate, no-plan and no-section null, and the timing stage; the negative control skips the resolution and the declared-capability test fails. Independently re-ran the head gate at 23f64fb23.
item_verdicts.goal: GOAL is 'Jev's state carries the node's declared capability and effort from its plan section' and the commit does exactly that: the section capability reaches the rendered state and the estimate is filled and labelled (node or plan) without overriding a request capability or a node estimate.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the commit, the base/head counts (179 vs 185, both EXIT 0), the negative control (1 failed EXIT 1) and the live-node before/after, but carries no armed baseline_suite/after_suite JSON blocks. added_failure_count/ids were derived from the reviewed run's own logs/base-gate.log and logs/head-gate.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the four paths the commit touches (reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py, reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py, tests/test_jev_sees_declared_difficulty.py, docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/jev-sees-declared-difficulty.html) all sit inside the declared scope; docs/figures/ was declared but not written, which the SPEC permitted (no figure named).

justifications.durability: Independently disabling the capability resolution (a runtime monkeypatch of picker._declared_difficulty in a scratch plugin) fails 4 tests including test_the_declared_capability_and_estimate_reach_jev, so the guard is shown to fire rather than merely to sit green, and the tests fail at the base revision.
justifications.evidence: base-gate.log (179 passed EXIT=0) and head-gate.log (185 passed EXIT=0) are on disk under the run directory, negative-control.log records 1 failed EXIT=1, and live-node-verification.log shows the reported node moving from capability null / hours None to orchestrator/deep/strict/critical and 48.0 source plan. Deducted for the head-arm log naming the base revision (finding evidence-head-log-names-base) and for the live check calling the helper directly rather than pick().
justifications.fit: the change extends pick() and build_state in the module's own idiom and reuses the routing resolver, but imports the private routing._estimated_hours across modules and renders estimated_hours_source only when a figure resolves, leaving the node key set variable; both were named options but the conditional key is an unusual shape.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all four SPEC done-when items are implemented and evidenced; the one live figure (48.0) follows the SPEC's named function routing._estimated_hours for the reported node.
justifications.reuse: the picker now calls the same routing.resolve_section_routing the dispatcher uses and the cached routing._estimated_hours rather than reimplementing difficulty resolution; no duplicated resolver or estimate logic was introduced.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in commit 23f64fb23 is inside the three declared write paths plus the SPEC-named evidence fragment; nothing outside the goal was added, and dispatch.py/cli.py/picker sibling modules the SPEC forbade were untouched.
